definition.interpretation: The initial numeric observation experiment provided execution samples but remained inconclusive regarding the hypothesis of resource allocation degradation, primarily because the instrument lacks an independent oracle for reasoning accuracy.
definition.limitations: The current experimental protocol relies on internal model reporting without cross-verification or external ground truth for reasoning quality.
definition.next_step: Refine the hypothesis to target specific failure modes in planning-heavy tasks rather than general resource allocation.

definition.cost: Minimal provider budget; focused on refinement.
definition.next_experiment: Define a protocol testing metareasoning latency against problem complexity thresholds.
definition.reason: The core question of how intelligent systems detect reasoning limits persists, necessitating further hypothesis refinement.
definition.stop_condition: Failure to establish a measurable causal link between metareasoning allocation and task accuracy after three experimental revisions.
definition.uncertainty: Optimal resource allocation between planning and execution remains theoretically elusive without better metric grounding.
